facts.statement: The second annual Super Fantomastique Halloween celebration ran in Free Realms, with costumes, decorations, quests and world events.
facts.quote: Le Super Fantomastique est de retour sur Free Realms!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (2ème Édition Annuelle de la Fête Super Fantomastique)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post for the second annual Super Fantomastique (Halloween) event in Free Realms. It covers costumes, Pixiewood decorations, the Trick or Treat activity with Harry Halloween, daily quests, the Pumpkin Prince and Vampire vs. Werewolf world events, a Bone Bog Cemetery member combat instance, and Halloween Trading Card Game quest packs. The post gives no absolute date, only a relative 'Posted 7 months, 2 weeks ago'.
